summary: Read a nonempty array of integers and a positive integer k. First count how many times each distinct integer occurs. Then choose the k distinct integers that occur most often. If several integers share a count, any of them may be written. Write those k integers. The time spent must be better than the bound of n times the logarithm of n, where n is the array length.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a count, that many integers, and one target integer.
